AwkBeats

Live

Developer & brand owner

Beat marketplace with lease tiers, sample packs, and booked sessions, built around Square checkout.

An online store for my own beats and a producer brand (Awkward J). Lease tiers, presets, sample packs, and booked sessions, with Square checkout and a download library. React/TypeScript front end, Express API, Supabase data. An iOS beat-store companion app is in progress.
